events.title: Node.js 服務阻斷漏洞
pts: Parse Server 8.6.115 與 9.10.7-alpha.1 之前版本驗證電子郵件時存在正規表示式漏洞。
CVSS為8.7，目前未遭利用。**未授權攻擊者可傳送特製長郵件阻塞 Node.js 事件循環造成服務阻斷。**
events.fix: 升級至 Parse Server 8.6.115 或 9.10.7-alpha.1 以上版本

raw.desc: Parse Server before 8.6.115 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.7-alpha.1 validates user email address format with a regular expression whose run time grows quadratically with input length and that is applied without a length limit. An unauthenticated attacker who knows the application ID can send a sign-up request, or a logged-in user can update their own email, with a long crafted email address to block the Node.js event loop and deny service to all clients.

raw.desc: There was a regression in how FIPS algorithms were enforced for the hashlib module. Only users that are using OpenSSL in FIPS mode are affected. Only Python 3.14.10 is affected, all other Python versions are unaffected.

events.title: OpenSSH 密碼驗證繞過漏洞
pts: 影響 Linux 上使用 musl libc 且未啟用 PAM 的 OpenSSH 10.6p2 前版本（例如 Alpine Linux），特定密碼長度可繞過驗證。
CVSS 評分為 8.1，**目前尚未發現漏洞遭實際利用或用於勒索軟體**。

raw.desc: sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. An example of a platform using musl libc without PAM is Alpine Linux.

events.title: IIS 多個高風險漏洞
pts: 同日公布 2 個漏洞，最高 CVSS 8.6。
ModSecurity is an open source, cross platform web application firewall (WAF) engine for Apache, IIS and Nginx. From 3.0.0 until 3.0.17, ModS
events.fix: 原文：This issue is fixed in version 3.0.17.

descs: ModSecurity is an open source, cross platform web application firewall (WAF) engine for Apache, IIS and Nginx. From 3.0.0 until 3.0.17, ModSecurity's multipart parser does not apply the RFC 2231 filename* parameter precedence used by common Go, Python, Node.js, and Java application parsers. A Content-Disposition header can provide a benign filename parameter for ModSecurity and a different encoded filename* value that the backend prefers, causing MULTIPART_FILENAME rules and the application to make security decisions on different names. Applications that use the backend-selected name for storage, extension checks, or content-type inference can therefore receive a filename that bypassed WAF inspection. PHP's native multipart parser is not affected by this discrepancy. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.17.

ModSecurity is an open source, cross platform web application firewall (WAF) engine for Apache, IIS and Nginx. From 3.0.0 until 3.0.17, src/transaction.cc compares a response Content-Type value against SecResponseBodyMimeType entries case-sensitively. A mixed-case response media type that is semantically equivalent to a configured lowercase type can therefore be treated as unconfigured, causing ModSecurity to skip RESPONSE_BODY inspection. An unauthenticated requester can then receive response content that a phase 4 rule would otherwise block, including sensitive error or debug data. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.17.

events.title: SQL Server 相關漏洞
pts: MariaDB 10.11.1至10.11.19等版本存在分區名稱編碼漏洞；Jumis於SQL Server使用固定演算法衍生之密碼。
CVSS為9.3，目前未遭利用。**攻擊者可利用已知演算法推算 SQL Server 的帳號密碼。**

descs: MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From 10.11.1 until 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2, ALTER TABLE ... CONVERT ... PARTITION does not apply filename encoding to user-specified partition names before using them in filesystem path construction. An authenticated database user can use a partition name requiring filename escaping to make the conversion operate on table files the user is not authorized to access, allowing unauthorized table reads or modifications. This issue is fixed in versions 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2.

Jumis (formerly Tildes Jumis) creates and uses a Microsoft SQL Server login named ##Tilde_JumisAdmin## whose password is derived deterministically from a single non-secret input - the SQL Server name (@@servername). The derivation algorithm is hard-coded in the client application and is identical across every installation; it contains a hard-coded secret key for entropy. Because the only input (the server name) is not secret - the instance suffix is hard-coded and the host name is discoverable via the SQL Server Browser service (UDP 1434), the TDS pre-login response, or DNS/NetBIOS - any party able to reach a Jumis SQL Server can compute the password offline and authenticate. The ##Tilde_JumisAdmin## login is a member of the sysadmin server role. Successful authentication therefore grants full administrative control of the SQL Server instance and read/write access to every customer's accounting database hosted on it. The on-premise server installation also programmatically enables xp_cmdshell during routine operation, so sysadmin access escalates to operating-system command execution on the database server.

raw.name: Cisco修補UCS Central遠端程式碼執行漏洞
raw.desc:
A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco UCS Central Software could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to achieve remote code execution or conduct information disclosure attacks on an affected device.

This vulnerability is due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input in an HTTP request. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted HTTP request to an affected endpoint on an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands, write arbitrary files to the filesystem, and obtain sensitive information. To exploit this vulnerability, the attacker must have valid user credentials on the affected device.
Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability.

events.fix: **升級至 0.0.3-release.3-patch.1 版本**

raw.desc: SharpEmu is an experimental PlayStation 5 emulator for Windows and Linux. In version 0.0.3-release.3 and earlier, the repository-provided debugger frontend tooling is vulnerable while running. This tooling is not included in the release archives. The frontend exposes an HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:8765 without authentication or CSRF token. Its  do_POST  handler in  tools/SharpEmu.DebuggerFrontend/debugger_frontend.py  does not validate the Origin, Referer, Sec-Fetch-Site, or Host headers. The  _read_json_body()  function also accepts JSON sent with browser-simple content types instead of requiring  application/json . A malicious page that can reach the loopback listener can send cross-origin requests to  /api/launch ,  /api/command , and  /api/connect . Chromium may require Local Network Access permission for pages served from public origins. Local-origin pages and other delivery paths are not consistently subject to this restriction. The  /api/launch  endpoint accepts an attacker-selected  emulatorPath  if it points to an existing file on the victim’s host. On POSIX systems, that file must also be executable. The endpoint additionally requires an existing  ebootPath . The  /api/command  endpoint exposes debugger operations, including  write-memory ,  set-register , and  continue . The  /api/connect  endpoint can initiate outbound TCP connections. These operations can let an attacker execute an existing binary with the victim’s privileges, control the attached emulated process, or reach network services accessible from the host. DNS rebinding can additionally let the attacker read API responses interactively. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.3-release.3-patch.1

raw.title: 歐洲超市冷凍設備遭駭，凸顯連網設備對外暴露與預設密碼風險
raw.desc: 2026 年 10 月起，歐洲超市的冷凍及冷藏設備接連遭到網路攻擊。攻擊者遠端修改設備的溫度與除霜設定，導致大量食品報廢。事件先發生在法國，11 月初再擴及比利時、荷蘭、瑞典、愛爾蘭等國。法國、荷蘭等國的資安機關已陸續發布警示，提醒業者檢視冷凍設備遠端監控系統的連網與存取管理。 法國約 700 家超市受害，CERT-FR 發布警報 第一波攻擊發生在 10 月 11 日夜間，法國數百家超市的冷藏設備遭遠端調高溫度，部分門市還傳出火災。法國財政部長 Roland Lescure 在國會表示，全國約 1 萬家超市中約 700 家受到影響，但糧食供應沒有風險。巴黎檢察署指出這是一起大規模攻擊，已交由網路犯罪單位偵辦，而法國總理 Sébastien Lecornu 也下令國家資訊系統安全局（ANSSI）調查，並與歐洲各國協調。 法國政府電腦緊急應變中心（CERT-FR）於 10 月 12 日發布警報 CERTFR-2026-ALE-012，之後兩度更新。警報列出的受影響設備包括 Danfoss AK-SM、AK-SC 系列控制器，以及 Copeland XWEB、Dixell XWEB 監控系統。CERT-FR 特別警告，已停止支援（EOL）的設備若持續暴露於網際網路，遭入侵的機率極高，單純恢復原廠設定，也無法消除再次遭入侵的風險。 11 月第二波攻擊，擴及歐洲多國 第二波攻擊發生在 11 月 1 日深夜至 2 日凌晨，比利時、荷蘭、瑞典、愛爾蘭等國的超市及食品業者陸續傳出冷凍設備溫度異常。根據 Euronews 11 月 3 日的報導，受影響範圍已擴及至少 10 個歐盟國家及英國，包括德國、義大利、羅馬尼亞等國。 冷凍設備為何能被遠端操控 大型超市的冷凍櫃並非各自獨立運作，而是由一台系統管理器集中控制各設備的溫度、除霜時段與警報。為了方便維護廠商遠端監看與調整，這類管理器多半內建網頁管理介面，並透過網路或行動網路路由器對外連線。 依目前官方與原廠的說明，攻擊者連上直接暴露於網際網路的管理介面，遠端調高溫度設定，或強制啟動除霜模式讓設備升溫，部分櫃內溫度最高達攝氏 50 度。荷蘭國家網路安全中心（NCSC-NL）指出，攻擊者利用弱密碼與預設密碼等方式取得遠端存取。Danfoss 也表示，荷蘭受害系統未置於安全網路，且仍使用預設密碼。Danfoss 表示，受影響的多為不再獲得更新的舊產品，原廠長期建議客戶更新或汰換，並建議系統不要能直接從網際網路連入。 各國官方防護建議 CERT-FR 與荷蘭 NCSC 建議使用相關設備的單位： 移除控制器與管理介面不必要的網際網路暴露。 確實需要遠端維運時，改用安全的 VPN 或受保護網路。 更換預設帳密、使用強密碼，並依原廠建議更新韌體；無法修補的停止支援設備應規劃汰換。 定期檢查溫度、除霜週期與警報設定；設備若已遭入侵，應先切斷對

pts: **Binance揭露約63.4億美元加密資產遭竊事件**，駭客透過假求職面試誘使工程師執行惡意程式，進而取得部署權限轉走資產。
攻擊源於工程師下載遭變造的Homebrew，資安團隊雖重設憑證，但相關同仁資訊已被駭客掌握。

raw.title: Binance揭露63億美元竊案攻擊鏈，駭客以假面試誘使工程師執行惡意程式
raw.desc: 全球最大加密貨幣交易平臺Binance公開約63.4億美元加密資產遭竊事件的初步調查，揭露駭客透過假求職面試植入惡意程式，再利用內部AI工具控制其他工程師電腦，取得容器部署權限，進而入侵錢包簽章服務轉走加密資產。 攻擊最早可追溯至今年6月，一名錢包維運工程師為了安裝AI程式開發工具，從搜尋結果下載遭變造的Homebrew安裝程式。Binance資安團隊雖然偵測異常，更換裝置並重設相關憑證，但該名工程師的職務及同事資訊已遭駭客取得。

events.title: Anthropic開源FlashProve，以密碼學驗證AI模型未遭掉包
pts: **Anthropic發表開源系統FlashProve**，利用零知識證明技術透過密碼學驗證AI回答是否確實來自指定模型。
該系統可防範服務供應商私下替換模型或竄改輸出，同時不必公開模型權重等商業機密。

raw.title: Anthropic開源FlashProve，以密碼學驗證AI模型未遭掉包
raw.desc: AI新創Anthropic周一（11/2）發表FlashProve，這是一套利用零知識證明（Zero-Knowledge Proof）技術開發的開源系統，可透過密碼學驗證AI回答是否確實來自指定模型，以偵測服務供應商是否私下替換模型，或遭駭客竄改輸出內容，同時不必公開模型權重等商業機密。Anthropic已公開相關技術報告、程式碼及形式化驗證工具，供外界研究與改進。

events.title: TeamViewer修補反向攻擊漏洞，受控端可藉遠端連線攻擊控制端
pts: **TeamViewer已修補高風險漏洞CVE-2026-111585，允許受控端反向攻擊控制端電腦。**
漏洞源於遠端畫面解壓縮處理程序的整數溢位，攻擊者可傳送特製畫面資料引發堆積緩衝區溢位。

raw.title: TeamViewer修補反向攻擊漏洞，受控端可藉遠端連線攻擊控制端
raw.desc: 廣獲使用的遠端桌面存取軟體TeamViewer於10月27日修補可能導致反向攻擊的高風險漏洞，漏洞編號CVE-2026-111585，CVSS嚴重性評分達8.8分。不同於一般遠端存取工具漏洞多是造成控制端攻擊受控端的情境，這個漏洞允許受控端反過來攻擊發起連線的控制端電腦，問題源自遠端畫面解壓縮處理程序的整數溢位，攻擊者可利用受控端傳送特製畫面資料，使控制端配置的記憶體緩衝區不足，進而造成堆積緩衝區溢位。

events.title: Node-RED重大漏洞出現攻擊嘗試，駭客企圖執行Linux惡意程式並部署網頁後門
pts: 駭客試圖利用 Node-RED 漏洞 CVE-2026-58115，於 Linux 系統下載並執行惡意程式。
**資安業者觀察到攻擊者試圖部署網頁後門**，以便後續持續執行遠端命令。

raw.title: Node-RED重大漏洞出現攻擊嘗試，駭客企圖執行Linux惡意程式並部署網頁後門
raw.desc: 資安漏洞情報業者VulnCheck近日揭露針對Node-RED重大漏洞CVE-2026-58115的攻擊活動。研究人員透過誘捕系統發現，攻擊者利用這項漏洞嘗試下載並執行Linux惡意程式，後續還觀測到試圖部署網頁後門、以便持續執行遠端命令的攻擊手法。

events.title: XCPE殭屍網路控制逾130萬臺機上盒，Google指控Android裝置製造商刻意預載後門
pts: **Google揭露XCPE殭屍網路控制全球逾130萬臺機上盒，指控製造商刻意預載後門程式。**
製造商Videostrong向犯罪夥伴販售裝置存取權限，用以從事廣告詐欺與轉送流量。

raw.title: XCPE殭屍網路控制逾130萬臺機上盒，Google指控Android裝置製造商刻意預載後門
raw.desc: Google威脅情報團隊（GTIG）近日揭露XCPE殭屍網路瓦解行動，這個殭屍網路控制全球超過130萬臺機上盒。Google調查發現，Android裝置製造商Videostrong Technology Co.涉嫌刻意在裝置韌體預載後門程式，並向犯罪合作夥伴販售裝置存取權限，協助部署對方開發的惡意模組。這些合作夥伴利用受感染裝置從事廣告詐欺，或將裝置變成常駐代理網路節點，替第三方轉送流量。

events.title: Aikido併購Cyberly及OutKept推出Noon資安平臺，整合AI工具管理與員工安全防護
pts: **Aikido Security併購Cyberly與OutKept，整合技術推出員工資安平臺Noon。**
平臺將業務從應用程式與雲端安全擴展至企業員工防護與AI工具管理。

raw.title: Aikido併購Cyberly及OutKept推出Noon資安平臺，整合AI工具管理與員工安全防護
raw.desc: 比利時資安業者Aikido Security今年9月先後併購波蘭資安業者Cyberly及比利時資安業者OutKept，並整合兩家公司的技術，於10月20日宣布推出員工資安平臺Noon，將原本以應用程式、程式碼及雲端安全為主的業務擴展至企業員工防護。

events.title: 雲端憑證遭竊成LLMJacking攻擊入口，企業AI模型資源被盜用牟利
pts: **攻擊者竊取雲端憑證與API金鑰進行LLMJacking攻擊，未經授權盜用企業AI模型資源。**
部分受害企業因此單日產生超過10萬美元的雲端使用費用。

raw.title: 雲端憑證遭竊成LLMJacking攻擊入口，企業AI模型資源被盜用牟利
raw.desc: Google旗下Mandiant公布2026年多起大型語言模型（LLM）資源遭盜用事件的調查結果，這類攻擊稱為LLMJacking。部分攻擊者利用遭竊的雲端存取憑證及API金鑰，未經授權大量使用企業的AI模型服務，部分受害企業因此單日產生超過10萬美元的雲端使用費用。

events.title: WP 外掛未妥善限制存取漏洞
pts: 影響 2.2.0 之前的 WP Remote Users Sync 外掛，使用 Nginx 伺服器會忽視 Apache 控制檔，**導致未授權存取匯出的個資**。
目前尚未遭利用；未授權攻擊者可預測匯出檔案名稱以取得使用者個人資料。

raw.desc: The WP Remote Users Sync WordPress plugin before 2.2.0 does not adequately restrict access to the user export files it writes beneath the public web root, relying on an Apache access-control file that other web servers such as Nginx ignore, which allows an unauthenticated attacker who requests the export's predictable file name while it is present to retrieve the exported users' personal data.

events.title: Chrome 遠端執行程式碼漏洞

CVSS 評分為 9.6，**目前尚未發現漏洞遭實際利用或用於勒索軟體**。

events.title: Puppet Server 安全漏洞
pts: 影響受影響版本中由 Puppet Server 使用的 Puppet 及 trapperkeeper-authorization。持有憑證者可**在伺服器執行任意程式碼**。
目前未遭利用。攻擊者需持有 CA 簽署之憑證，透過提交特製報告或利用憑證名稱比對漏洞進行冒充。

descs: Deserialization of untrusted data in the report-processing code of Puppet, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected releases, allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as its service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type via PUT request. Where the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain such a certificate.

Incorrect authorization in the certificate-name matching of trapperkeeper-authorization, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected products, allows a client that holds a CA-signed certificate whose name extends or shortens an authorized hostname to be authorized as that host. This enables impersonation of other nodes and, in Puppet Enterprise, access to certificate-authority administration and remote command execution on managed nodes. Exploitation requires a certificate with a colliding name, which the certificate authority issues by approval or autosign.

raw.desc: A flaw in the connection management layer of the MongoDB Node.js driver can leave a pooled network connection in the pool for reuse while data from an earlier operation is still outstanding on it. In applications that enable an optional client-side operation timeout, an unauthenticated party that can send ordinary requests to the application may cause database replies to be paired with the wrong requests. This may result in unintended disclosure of other users' records, incorrect operation results being returned, and failures of legitimate requests.

events.title: Linux 核心釋放後重用漏洞
pts: Linux 核心存在 TIPC 重置追蹤與 TCP reqsk_timer_handler() 釋放後重用（UAF）漏洞。
**目前尚未發現漏洞遭惡意利用**，包含 CVE-2026-99246 與 CVE-2026-99270。

descs:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tipc: protect node reset trace dump with node lock

The tipc_node_reset_links trace event asks tipc_node_dump() to walk the
node's link entries. Unlike the other node events that request link data,
this event runs without the node lock.

This permits bearer teardown to free a link while the trace callback is
dumping it:

  CPU 0                                CPU 1
  trace_tipc_node_reset_links()
    tipc_node_dump()
      l = n->links[0].link
                                       tipc_node_write_lock()
                                       kfree(l)
                                       n->links[0].link = NULL
                                       tipc_node_write_unlock()
      tipc_link_dump(l)

tipc_link_dump() then dereferences the stale pointer. KASAN reported:

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in tipc_link_dump
  Read of size 4 by task poc/115
  Call Trace:
   tipc_link_dump+0x10cb/0x16b0
   tipc_node_dump+0x4bb/0x740
   trace_event_raw_event_tipc_node_class+0x258/0x360
   tipc_node_reset_links+0x14d/0x1a0
   tipc_rcv+0x13f5/0x3030
   tipc_udp_recv+0x4e3/0x670
  Allocated by task 0:
   tipc_link_create+0x1e1/0x1020
   tipc_node_check_dest+0x7d2/0x11a0
   tipc_disc_rcv+0xdbf/0x1430
  Freed by task 89:
   kfree+0x131/0x3c0
   tipc_node_link_down+0x267/0x4b0
   tipc_node_delete_links+0xec/0x160
   bearer_disable+0x107/0x260

Take the node write lock around the trace event. This serializes the
dump against tipc_node_link_down(delete=true), which frees the link
under the same write lock.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tcp: Fix potential UAF in reqsk_timer_handler().

When TCP socket migration fails at inet_ehash_insert() in
reqsk_timer_handler(), we jump to the no_ownership: label
and free the new reqsk immediately with __reqsk_free().

Thus, we must stop the new reqsk's timer before jumping to the
label, but the timer might be missed since the cited commit,
resulting in UAF.

As we are in the original reqsk's timer context, we can safely
call timer_delete_sync() for the new reqsk.

Let's pass false to __inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop() to stop
the new reqsk's timer.

raw.desc: The Advanced Custom Fields: Extended PRO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 0.9.2.6 via the render_field function. This is due to insufficient validation of form configuration parameters before merging into field settings and passing to call_user_func_array in the render_field method. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to call arbitrary WordPress functions with controlled arguments. Method 1 requires the administrator to enable the non-default 'shortcode_preview' setting for the target form, while Method 2 requires the server environment to lack OpenSSL functions, causing ACF Pro's acf_decrypt to fall back to unverified base64 decoding.

其中96%的攻擊持續不到10分鐘，98%攻擊流量低於1Gbps，超大流量攻擊則有所減少。

raw.title: 2026年第3季DDoS攻擊次數年增208%，短時間攻擊考驗企業防禦能力
raw.desc: 網路服務與資安業者Cloudflare公布2026年第3季分散式阻斷服務（DDoS）攻擊趨勢，該公司在旗下全球網路攔截1,820萬次網路層DDoS攻擊，較去年同期增加208%，平均每小時約8,226次。其中96%的攻擊持續不到10分鐘，98%的攻擊流量速率低於1Gbps。不過，超過1Tbps的超大流量攻擊從前一季805次降至251次，減少近69%。

攻擊者存取服務容器並上傳未授權提款指令，平台已暫停存提款並註銷受影響IP授權。

raw.title: Binance遭竊約63億美元加密貨幣，創史上最大竊案，調查指向北韓駭客
raw.desc: 加密貨幣交易平臺Binance上周五公告10月29日發生資安事件，電子錢包遭人竊取63億美元等值token，但公司承諾會全額賠償。美國聯邦調查局（FBI）指北韓駭客為背後元兇。 Binance周五初步調查顯示，事件可能和一名DevOps工程師筆電被入侵有關，讓攻擊者得以存取服務容器，並上傳未經授權的提款交易指令。該公司第一時間暫停加密貨幣存、提款，並註銷受影響錢包IP位址的授權、通報執法機關，也和區塊鏈夥伴合作凍結在區塊鏈上的加密貨幣，也尚未發現任何錢包私有金鑰外洩的證據。

pts: konflux-ci 的 UI 代理伺服器自動停用 TLS 驗證，**相鄰網路攻擊者可擷取憑證並取得叢集完整控制權**。
漏洞發布於 2026 年 10 月 31 日，目前尚未遭惡意利用。

raw.desc: A flaw was found in konflux-ci. This vulnerability allows privilege escalation when the user interface proxy automatically disables Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate verification for connections to internal backend services in environments lacking a default service certificate authority. Because the proxy attaches a cluster-scoped authentication token with user impersonation rights to these requests, an adjacent network attacker capable of intercepting traffic can capture the credentials to gain full administrative control of the cluster.

events.title: Refitter工具安全漏洞
pts: 影響 Refitter 2.1.1 及 2.1.2 以前版本。解析 OpenAPI 時因不安全預設值或引號未轉義，可能導致安全漏洞與屬性注入。
**目前尚未發現漏洞遭利用**。攻擊者需透過可控制或影響的 OpenAPI 描述檔誘發漏洞。
events.fix: 升級至 Refitter 2.1.2 以上版本

descs: Refitter is a tool for generating a C# REST API client using the Refit library. Prior to 2.1.1, the `refitter` dotnet tool invokes `NJsonSchema` with unsafe defaults for `$ref` resolution when generating Refit interfaces and contracts from attacker-controlled or attacker-influenced OpenAPI descriptions. Remote `http(s)` references cause requests from the developer or CI host and inline untrusted remote schema content into generated output. Absolute local file paths and relative `../` traversal outside the input directory also resolve and inline local content, permitting arbitrary local-file disclosure. The demonstrated chain stops at server-side request forgery, remote file inclusion, and local file inclusion, not code execution: Refit sets the base URL at runtime, enum values use verbatim-string doubling, and string defaults are escaped. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.1.

Refitter is a tool for generating a C# REST API client using the Refit library. Prior to 2.1.2, content-type keys in the content maps of `requestBody/responses` are emitted verbatim into a Refit `[Headers("Accept: <ct>", "Content-Type: <ct>")]` attribute string without escaping quotation marks. A crafted content-type key in an attacker-influenced OpenAPI description survives default validation without `--skip-validation`, breaks out of the attribute string and enclosing interface and namespace, and can introduce a top-level file class while leaving valid generated C#. A `[ModuleInitializer]` method in that class executes attacker code when the generated assembly is loaded at application startup, without requiring a call to the client. The behavior was verified with Refitter 2.0.0 and .NET 8. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.2.

Refitter is a tool for generating a C# REST API client using the Refit library. Prior to 2.1.2, OpenAPI `paths`-object keys are emitted verbatim into Refit route attributes such as `[Get("<path>")]` without escaping quotation marks or restricting characters. An attacker-influenced single-line, slash-prefixed path survives default validation without `--skip-validation` and can close the attribute string, interface, and namespace while introducing a top-level file class and reopening the generated structure to keep valid C#. A `[ModuleInitializer]` method executes attacker code when an application compiles and loads the generated assembly at startup, even without calling the generated client. The enum and default value sinks are escaped and are not the vulnerable path-emission sink. The behavior was verified on Refitter 2.0.0 with .NET 8. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.2.

Refitter is a tool for generating a C# REST API client using the Refit library. Prior to 2.1.2, the header parameter name in `parameters[].name` with `in: header` is emitted verbatim into a Refit `[Header("<name>")]` attribute string without escaping quotation marks. An attacker-influenced OpenAPI description can pass default validation without `--skip-validation` and break out from the parameter-list position by closing the parameter and method syntax, attribute, interface, and namespace. The generated file can remain valid C# while containing a top-level file class with a `[ModuleInitializer]` method, which executes attacker code when the compiled assembly is loaded at application startup, even if the client is never called. Query `AliasAs` and enum/default value sinks are escaped; this flaw is in header-name attribute-string emission. The behavior was verified with Refitter 2.0.0 and .NET 8. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.2.

events.title: Blender與pgAdmin漏洞
pts: 影響 Blender 4.5.15 與 5.2.3 前版本及 pgAdmin 4，可造成堆疊緩衝區溢位等問題。
CVSS 評分為 8.5，**目前尚無漏洞遭惡意利用或用於勒索軟體攻擊之紀錄**。

descs: Blender before 4.5.15 and 5.x before 5.2.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the blend file thumbnail extractor caused by 32-bit integer overflow in thumb_data_vertical_flip(). Attackers can craft a .blend file with malicious TEST block dimensions that trigger an out-of-bounds write when blender-thumbnailer or the Windows shell extension previews it, causing crashes or code execution.

pgAdmin 4 runs pg_dump, pg_restore, pg_dumpall and psql from the binary path a user sets in their preferences. In server mode the binary path was refused only when it lay under the per-user storage directory (STORAGE_DIR), not under a SHARED_STORAGE directory, which ordinary users can upload files to. A user could therefore upload an executable to shared storage, point their binary path at it, and have pgAdmin run it as the operating-system account running pgAdmin. On POSIX, files created through pgAdmin are not executable, so this is exploitable where any file with an executable name can run, such as Windows server mode.

The fix checks the binary path against every SHARED_STORAGE directory as well, after expanding $DIR, collapsing ".." and resolving symbolic links, compares directories in a way a different spelling on a case-insensitive filesystem cannot bypass, refuses a path containing a NUL, and enforces the check wherever binary paths are resolved, including for the PSQL tool.

This issue affects pgAdmin 4: before 9.19.

events.title: SPMP 權限繞過與 XSS 漏洞
pts: 影響 ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP)。圖表功能存在儲存型跨網站指令碼漏洞，且 MFA 功能存在不當存取控制漏洞。
CVSS 評分為 8.5，目前尚無遭利用跡象。**低權限驗證使用者可繞過授權檢查並修改 MFA 設定**。

descs: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the chart feature of SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP) due to improper sanitization and HTML encoding of user-controlled data. An attacker can inject malicious HTML or JavaScript into attributes used to generate charts, including users' full names, site names, or group names. The injected content is stored and subsequently executed in the context of other users' browsers when the affected charts are rendered. This vulnerability was fixed in client application build 4508.

An improper access control vulnerability exists in the multi-factor authentication (MFA) functionality of ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP). A low-privileged authenticated user can bypass authorization checks to read and modify MFA configuration settings, enable or disable MFA for the application, enumerate MFA-enrolled users, and delete MFA-enrolled accounts. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to weaken authentication protections or cause a denial of service by configuring invalid MFA settings, potentially locking legitimate users out of the application. This vulnerability was fixed in build 4507. The reproduction explicitly uses build 4506.

The injected content is stored and subsequently executed in the context of other users' browsers when the affected charts are rendered. This vulnerability was fixed in client application build 4508.

events.title: Nginx 權限提升漏洞
pts: 影響 Cloud Controller 的 Nginx 路由設定。未限制 /internal/v3/ 端點，導致回呼端點無需 OAuth 或雙向 TLS 認證即可存取。
CVSS 評分為 8.8，目前尚無遭利用跡象。**攻擊者取得 GUID 後可提交偽造回呼以進行權限提升**。

raw.desc:
The Nginx routing configuration for Cloud Controller blocks unauthenticated access to /internal/v4/ and /internal/v5/ endpoints but omits an equivalent deny rule for /internal/v3/. As a result, the staging callback endpoints /internal/v3/staging/:guid/droplet_completed and /internal/v3/staging/:guid/build_completed are reachable from the public API listener without OAuth or mutual TLS.



 



An attacker with a valid build or droplet GUID can submit a forged staging callback, transition a droplet to STAGED, and persist arbitrary process metadata and sidecar data with no associated package or actor. A SpaceAuditor can enumerate GUIDs without write permissions, making this an effective privilege escalation beyond the intended role boundary.

pts: 思科 Secure Firewall ASA 與 FTD 之 SSL VPN 服務存在 DoS 漏洞 CVE-2026-76418。
**該漏洞已遭實際利用**，未授權攻擊者可導致防火牆重啟中斷服務，原廠呼籲儘速升級。

raw.title: 思科修補防火牆已遭積極利用的阻斷服務漏洞
raw.desc: 10月28日思科發布資安公告，旗下Secure Firewall ASA與FTD防火牆系統的SSL VPN服務存在高風險漏洞，未通過身分驗證的攻擊者可導致防火牆意外重新啟動，造成服務中斷（DoS）的現象，此弱點被登記為CVE-2026-76418列管，CVSS嚴重程度評為8.6分。值得留意的是，思科已發現漏洞遭到實際利用的跡象，由於沒有其他完整的替代緩解措施，呼籲用戶儘速升級新版軟體進行修補。

events.title: Hive與Nefilim勒索軟體集團成員遭美國判刑，將入獄70個月

**該名成員於 2021 年 6 月加入並將獲取贖金的 20% 交給集團管理者**。

raw.title: Hive與Nefilim勒索軟體集團成員遭美國判刑，將入獄70個月

events.title: 日本航空第三方訂位系統遭入侵，約9.2萬名旅客資料受影響
pts: 日本航空與日本越洋航空採用的第三方旅客服務系統遭外部擅自存取，**影響約9.2萬名旅客的訂位資料**。
受影響資料包含訂位代號、姓名與航班資訊，其中約2,000名旅客資料另涵蓋護照號碼與電子郵件。

raw.title: 日本航空第三方訂位系統遭入侵，約9.2萬名旅客資料受影響
raw.desc: 日本航空（Japan Airlines，JAL）與日本越洋航空（Japan Transocean Air，JTA）於10月28日公告，兩家公司使用的第三方旅客服務系統遭外部人士擅自存取，約9.2萬名旅客的訂位代號、姓名及航班資訊等資料受影響，其中約2,000名旅客的資料還包括護照號碼、電子郵件地址等個資。

events.title: 年末購物旺季將至，Palo Alto Networks示警零售業面臨多重網路威脅
pts: Palo Alto Networks發布報告指出，**零售業者於年底購物旺季面臨升高的網路攻擊風險**。
攻擊者可能趁業者忙於應付交易高峰，以及系統更新與調整受限之際發動攻擊。

raw.title: 年末購物旺季將至，Palo Alto Networks示警零售業面臨多重網路威脅
raw.desc: 每年的年底是零售購物的高峰，隨著銷售旺季到來，Palo Alto Networks於10月28日發布報告，示警零售業者與消費者面臨的網路攻擊風險升高，攻擊者可能趁零售業者忙於應付交易高峰、系統更新與調整受限的時機發動攻擊。

events.title: DEVCORE研究員公布在Pwn2Own競賽揭露的Edge攻擊鏈，串連5個弱點突破瀏覽器防護機制
pts: DEVCORE研究員公開Pwn2Own競賽中的Edge攻擊鏈，串連5個邏輯漏洞突破瀏覽器防護。
**攻擊過程不依賴記憶體損毀，最終成功於作業系統執行任意程式碼**。

raw.title: DEVCORE研究員公布在Pwn2Own競賽揭露的Edge攻擊鏈，串連5個弱點突破瀏覽器防護機制
raw.desc: 臺灣資安公司DEVCORE首席資安研究員Orange Tsai（蔡政達）於10月28日，公開在漏洞挖掘競賽Pwn2Own Berlin 2026首度展示的Edge瀏覽器完整攻擊鏈細節，過程中只利用邏輯漏洞，不依賴記憶體損毀，成功突破瀏覽器安全防護，最終在作業系統執行任意程式碼。

raw.title: 日本樂天兩個旅遊網站遭駭外洩用戶個資354萬，臺灣網站不受影響

events.title: AI加快漏洞發現，CSA提出VulnOps模式改善企業漏洞管理
pts: 因應AI加速漏洞發現，雲端安全聯盟（CSA）提出VulnOps模式以改善企業漏洞管理。
**主張企業應持續追蹤並處理漏洞而非僅靠批次修補**，避免新發生的安全問題持續累積。

raw.title: AI加快漏洞發現，CSA提出VulnOps模式改善企業漏洞管理
raw.desc: AI加快漏洞發現速度，但企業確認漏洞影響、測試修補程式及部署更新仍需要時間。雲端安全聯盟（Cloud Security Alliance，CSA）提出VulnOps漏洞管理模式，主張企業不應只依賴定期掃描及批次修補，而應持續追蹤並處理漏洞，避免新發現的安全問題不斷累積。

events.title: 惡意Markdown指引檔企圖誘使Codex安裝惡意套件，AI程式開發代理面臨攻擊風險
pts: 研究人員發現惡意AGENTS.md檔案，**企圖誘使OpenAI Codex修改設定並安裝惡意NPM套件**。
此事件顯示攻擊者可將惡意指令藏入供AI程式開發代理讀取的Markdown指引檔中。

raw.title: 惡意Markdown指引檔企圖誘使Codex安裝惡意套件，AI程式開發代理面臨攻擊風險
raw.desc: 資安業者Forever Security近日揭露一起利用惡意Markdown檔案攻擊AI程式開發代理的事件。研究人員在客戶電腦的下載資料夾發現惡意AGENTS.md檔案，攻擊者企圖誘使OpenAI Codex修改設定並安裝名為function-color的惡意NPM套件，但資安防護系統阻止了套件安裝。AGENTS.md是供AI程式開發代理讀取的Markdown指引檔，攻擊者將惡意指令藏入其中。

events.title: Ivanti 權限提升漏洞
pts: 影響 Ivanti Connect Secure，包含可預測識別碼與驗證缺失漏洞，可導致檔案上傳或權限提升。
**此漏洞目前已被證實遭利用**，遠端或本地已驗證攻擊者可利用或串聯漏洞。
events.fix: 依原廠公告套用修補或緩解措施，無法修補時停用該產品。

descs: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.
raw.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

events.title: 千家臺灣中小企業採用，老牌印度協作軟體業者主打企業級AI、擴大在臺布局
pts: 印度協作軟體業者Zoho宣佈擴大在臺布局，主打由大型語言模型驅動的Zia Chat等企業級AI工具。
目前**已有逾千家臺灣中小企業導入**，業者強調軟體均為自行開發維運以降低資安風險。

raw.title: 千家臺灣中小企業採用，老牌印度協作軟體業者主打企業級AI、擴大在臺布局
raw.desc: 老牌印度協作軟體公司Zoho今日來臺舉辦首次媒體說明會，要擴大在臺的產品推廣規模，主打企業級AI生產力與營運工具產品線，包括由大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的Zia Chat、可融入工作流程執行任務的Zia Agents，以及提供50多支應用程式的Zoho One一站式平臺。 Zoho亞太區董事總經理Gibu Mathew透露，臺灣市場營收在過去一年成長了54%，目前已有1千多家臺灣中小企業導入Zoho服務。他也強調，Zoho旗下60多支應用程式皆自行開發、維運，比起企業選用不同廠牌軟體、來回切換登入，資安風險更低。

events.title: 行動App安全規範與技術持續更新，執行環境防護與白箱加密成焦點
pts: 行動App安全規範與防護技術持續演進，業界介紹政策趨勢與白箱密碼學等技術進展。
**越南自今年3月起將Bootloader等檢查納入行動銀行App法規，顯示對執行環境提出具體安全要求。**

raw.title: 行動App安全規範與技術持續更新，執行環境防護與白箱加密成焦點
raw.desc: 行動應用安全雖是發展多年的成熟議題，但相關政策指引、國際標準與防護技術仍持續演進。近日，在臺代理Digital.ai應用程式防護解決方案的叡揚資訊，介紹這方面的政策與標準趨勢，以及白箱密碼學等技術進展，也讓我們進一步注意到行動應用安全領域的最新防護動向。 首先是政策與規範面的變化，叡揚資訊資安直屬事業處資安技術顧問李易潤表示，越南從今年3月開始，已將開機載入程式（Bootloader）等檢查納入行動銀行App的法規要求，這顯示部分國家已進一步針對行動App的執行環境訂出具體安全要求。

events.title: AI降低App逆向分析門檻帶來資安挑戰，企業App安全策略須兼顧發布後防護
pts: AI與自動化工具加速App逆向分析，攻擊者能更快掌握邏輯以繞過機制、竄改或重新封裝程式碼。
**業者建議強化程式碼混淆，並結合伺服器端動態風險回應以因應App安全威脅。**

raw.title: AI降低App逆向分析門檻帶來資安挑戰，企業App安全策略須兼顧發布後防護
raw.desc: 過去需要耗費大量時間的部分App逆向分析工作，如今可透過AI與自動化工具大幅加速。逆向工程雖可用於合法的資安研究與安全驗證，但若被攻擊者利用，也可能更快掌握App內部運作邏輯，進一步尋找繞過安全機制、竄改程式碼或重新封裝App的機會，讓既有加殼與程式碼保護機制面臨考驗。專精於App安全的Digital.ai與其臺灣代理商叡揚資訊，在臺介紹這方面的技術變化，並提出強化程式碼混淆，以及結合伺服器端動態風險回應等防禦新方向。

events.title: Chrome 與組件遠端執行漏洞
pts: 影響 156.0.8078.79 前的 Chrome 與 0.9.5 前的 Crawl4AI。攻擊者可**執行任意程式碼**或攔截爬蟲流量。
目前未遭利用。攻擊者可透過中間人攻擊、DNS 控制或誘導使用者存取特製 HTML 網頁發動攻擊。

events.title: Apache Qpid Proton 憑證驗證漏洞
pts: 影響 0.40.0 及先前版本的 Apache Qpid Proton C，在使用 OpenSSL TLS 時因 API 未替換預設信任錨點，可能導致信任未預期的對等憑證。
CVSS 評分為 9.1，此漏洞不影響 Win32 SChannel TLS 實作，目前尚未發現遭利用。
events.fix: **升級至 0.41.1 版本**；或將應用程式的 SSL_CERT_FILE 環境變數設定為 /dev/null。

raw.desc:
When using the OpenSSL TLS implementation, both the pn_ssl_domain_set_trusted_ca_db() & pn_tls_config_set_trusted_certs() APIs added to rather than replaced the default system trust anchors. Leading to potentially trusting unexpected peer certificates.



This can be worked around by setting the SSL_CERT_FILE environment variable for the application to /dev/null.



This issue does not affect the Win32 SChannel TLS implementation.



This issue affects Apache Qpid Proton C: through 0.40.0.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.41.1, which fixes the issue.

raw.title: 駭客利用AI滲透測試工具ARTEX竊取韓國金融業資料
raw.desc: 資安廠商CrowdStrike於2026年10月7日揭露一起涉及韓國金融機構的資料竊取事件，指出攻擊者疑似濫用名為ARTEX的AI輔助滲透測試工具發動攻擊。研究人員從攻擊者的公開目錄，取得ARTEX的相關設定檔與操作紀錄。發現攻擊活動涉及多種大型語言模型及代理伺服器(Proxy)，顯示攻擊者可能運用 AI 工具輔助執行攻擊作業。顯示攻擊者可能運用 AI 工具輔助執行攻擊作業。目前尚未將相關活動歸因至特定進階持續性威脅（Advanced Persistent Threat, APT）組織。 另外，依據韓國金融委員會於2026年10月16日公布的調查報告，當地共有16家金融企業發生資料外洩事件，總計涉及約10萬筆客戶資料。然而，前述事件是否皆與ARTEX攻擊活動相關，目前仍待進一步釐清。 ARTEX原為滲透測試(Penetration Testing)工具，可透過大型語言模型處理測試指令，協助執行入侵模擬及系統弱點檢測。根據 CrowdStrike 分析，2026年9月下旬至10月上旬的相關紀錄，包含AI工具Claude Code對話與記憶檔操作日誌。攻擊者主要採用DeepSeek v4.1-flash，攻擊者另在Claude Code工作階段使用GLM-5.3與Grok 4.6，顯示其可能透過不同 AI 模型協助執行攻擊作業。 此外，攻擊者以雲端主機作為操作環境相關行為可對應 MITRE ATT&CK 技術編號 T1583.003(Virtual Private Server)及T1588.007(Artificial Intelligence)。同時，攻擊者亦透過代理伺服器轉送網路流量，以增加追查來源的難度。 CrowdStrike 公布9個相關代理IP位址，建議企業回溯內部日誌時，將其納入威脅情資比對，並交叉檢視防火牆、VPN、代理伺服器及其他網路設備的連線紀錄，以及資料庫查詢與資料傳輸紀錄，以確認是否存在異常存取或資料外傳行為。 根據韓國金融委員會於2026年10月14日公布的外洩統計調查，受影響資料包含客戶姓名、聯絡資訊、電子郵件及韓國住民登錄號（相當於臺灣的身分證字號），暫無帳戶密碼或信用卡號外洩通報。主管機關亦要求業者封鎖攻擊來源、修補現存弱點，並於必要時暫停對外服務以策安全。 此外，研究人員根據攻擊者操作紀錄研判，攻擊者可能使用中文，但目前尚無足夠證據將其歸因至特定威脅組織。至於攻擊者如何取得初始存取權限、是否利用特定軟體弱點，以及相關受影響軟體版本、CVE 編號與 CVSS 嚴重度評分，現有公開資訊尚未提供明確說明。而ARTEX開發者Autumn-27雖已於2026年10月8日宣布停止更新與維護，並關閉公開原始碼，然而，工具停止維護並不代表既有攻擊活動或相關威脅已獲控制，企業仍應持續追蹤後續調查與威脅情資。 為防範類似利用AI 自動化工具進行之

raw.desc: A vulnerability in the Remote Access SSL VPN service of Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the affected device to reload, resulting in a DoS condition.

events.title: n8n 跨站腳本與權限繞過漏洞
pts: n8n 1.123.85、2.43.5 及 2.44.1 以前版本存在儲存型 XSS 漏洞，且工作流 ID 快取邏輯可被繞過。
具權限之已驗證使用者可**利用特製 ID 繞過檢查並列出資料表**。目前未遭利用。

descs: n8n before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because some webhook response paths, such as error responses and responses without headers, omit the sandbox Content-Security-Policy. Authenticated members who can create and activate workflows can serve HTML that runs on the n8n origin, letting scripts act with the session of users who open the webhook URL.

n8n before 2.43.5 and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 accepts a client-supplied workflow ID and caches each workflow's owner project in memory by that ID, so a crafted ID such as __proto__ makes the Data Table project check match every project. An authenticated member who can create and run workflows can list, read, modify, and delete Data Table rows in all projects of the instance.

n8n before 2.43.5 and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 accepts a client-supplied workflow ID and caches each workflow's owner project in memory by that ID, so a crafted ID such as __proto__ makes the Data Table project check match every project. An authenticated member who can create and run workflows can list, read, modify, and delete Data Table rows in all projects of the instance.

n8n before 2.43.5 and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 accepts a client-supplied workflow ID and caches each workflow's owner project in memory by that ID, so a crafted ID such as __proto__ makes the Data Table project check match every project. An authenticated member who can create and run workflows can list, read, modify, and delete Data Table rows in all projects of the instance.

n8n before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because some webhook response paths, such as error responses and responses without headers, omit the sandbox Content-Security-Policy. Authenticated members who can create and activate workflows can serve HTML that runs on the n8n origin, letting scripts act with the session of users who open the webhook URL.

events.title: XWiki 遠端執行程式碼漏洞
pts: XWiki Remote Macros 1.13 至 1.14.5 未適當跳脫標題，可遭注入語法並導致遠端執行程式碼，影響系統機密性、完整性與可用性。
目前未遭利用。具頁面編輯權限的使用者即使無腳本或程式設計權限亦可觸發。

raw.desc: XWiki Remote Macros provides XWiki rendering macros that are useful when migrating content from Confluence. From 1.13 until 1.14.5, the `excerpt-include` macro does not properly escape the included page's title and executes `excerpt` content with the macro's rights. The title handling in `xwiki-pro-macros-ui/src/main/resources/Confluence/Macros/ExcerptInclude.xml` and the rendering of `excerpt` content into XWiki syntax both allow syntax injection. Any user able to edit a page, even without script or programming rights, can supply executable macro syntax in the title or `excerpt` and cause remote code execution when the page is included. This affects confidentiality, integrity and availability of the whole XWiki installation. This issue is fixed in version 1.14.5.

descs:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfs: fix capability check in xfs

An user reported a bug where he managed to evade group's quota
by changing a file's gid to a different group id the same user
belonged to, even though quotas were enforced on both gids and the
file's size was big enough to exceed the quota's hardlimit.

Commit eba0549bc7d1 replaced a capable() call by a
has_capability_noaudit() to prevent unnecessary selinux audit messages.
Turns out that both calls have slightly different semantics even though
their documentation seems similar. Where in a nutshell:

capable() - Tests the task's effective credentials
has_ns_capability_noaudit() - Tests the task's real credentials

This most of the time has no practical difference but in some cases like
changing attrs (specifically group id in this case) through a NFS client
this will allow the quota code to use XFS_QMOPT_FORCE_RES, effectively
bypassing quota accounting checks.

Using instead ns_capable_noaudit() should fix this issue and prevent
selinux audit messages.

This also fix the remaining calls to has_capability_noaudit()

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

scsi: libiscsi: Validate the ITT reflected in a Reject PDU

A Reject PDU carries a copy of the header it rejects, and
iscsi_handle_reject() takes the ITT out of that copy to find the task to
clean up:

      memcpy(&rejected_pdu, data, sizeof(struct iscsi_hdr));
      ...
      task = iscsi_itt_to_task(conn, rejected_pdu.itt);

That value is whatever the target put there. iscsi_itt_to_task() bounds
the index against cmds_max and checks nothing else, so any task in the
pool can be named, and iscsi_nop_out_rsp() then completes it.

An index that has never been used gives a NULL task->conn: the pool is
zeroed at session setup and conn is assigned only when a task is
allocated. If the task was used and returned, iscsi_complete_task() hits
its WARN_ON_ONCE(task->state == ISCSI_TASK_FREE) and the refcount
underflows. An in-flight SCSI command is completed as successful - a 1
MiB read returned 1048576 with none of its buffer written and no
warning.

Validate the reflected ITT the way iscsi_itt_to_ctask() validates a
command ITT, and require the task to be in flight and not a SCSI
command.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

scsi: libiscsi: Reject a negative task index from parse_pdu_itt

A transport that implements parse_pdu_itt hands libiscsi an index taken
from the PDU, and both lookups bound it from above only:

      if (i >= session->cmds_max)

i and cmds_max are both int, so a negative index passes and
session->cmds[i] is read from before the array.

be2iscsi produces one. beiscsi_parse_pdu() assigns the raw tag,

      *index = (int)itt;

and beiscsi_complete_pdu() forwards an unsolicited NOP-In from the
hardware async ring without replacing its ITT, so the value is the
target's. It also reports the session's own age rather than the one in
the tag, which leaves the age comparison in iscsi_verify_itt() with
nothing to reject.

Bound the index from below in both lookups.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

namespace: a mount that copy_tree() leaves out can't take over a lock

Since commit c62a4766937e ("move_mount: transfer MNT_LOCKED") a mount
can be moved beneath a locked mount. The lock moves from the old cover
to the new mount which takes over the job of hiding what's under it and
the old cover can be unmounted. That works as long as the new mount
stays. But the caller picks the new mount and copy_tree() leaves a
mount of a mount namespace file out of every copy made without
CL_COPY_MNT_NS_FILE, together with everything mounted on it, and never
looks at MNT_LOCKED. unshare(CLONE_NEWNS) and mount propagation make
such copies.

So a task that is root in its own user namespace gets rid of a locked
cover on a file without a race and without touching the filesystem
below it. It makes a child with a mount namespace of its own, binds the
child's /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt beneath the cover with MOVE_MOUNT_BENEATH,
which hands the lock to that bind, and calls unshare(CLONE_NEWNS). The
new mount namespace has nothing on the file. That's the usual way to
mask a single file, a bind of /dev/null or of an empty file. With a
bind of an ordinary file the file stays covered.

copy_tree() already refuses to leave out a locked unbindable mount with
-EPERM since commit df7342b24018 ("mount: Don't allow copying
MNT_UNBINDABLE|MNT_LOCKED mounts"). Do the same for a locked mount of a
mount namespace file. That also covers a tree copied with
CL_COPY_MNT_NS_FILE and attached into a mount namespace of another user
namespace where lock_mnt_tree() locks it. Note that unshare(CLONE_NEWNS)
and clone(CLONE_NEWNS) fail with EPERM from such a mount namespace from
then on. The mount can't be left out and it can't be unmounted.

And refuse to move a mount of a mount namespace file beneath a locked
mount in the first place. Otherwise the task ends up with a mount it
can't unmount and an unshare() that fails for good.

Chris also found a second mount that goes away by itself, a clone of an
automounted mount that shrink_submounts() took along with its parent.
Commit f78ddcc87224 ("namespace: never expire a locked mount") took
care of that one.

Chris's reproducer is appended. Mode nsfile reads SECRET after the
unshare() on 7.3-rc7, with this patch the move_mount() fails with
EINVAL and the file stays covered. nsfile-control uses an ordinary file
and reads MASK both ways.

  // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0
  /*
   * Get rid of a locked cover with MOVE_MOUNT_BENEATH.
   *
   * The "admin" (root) makes a tmpfs W:
   *     W/D         file, holds SECRET, covered by a bind of a file with MASK
   *     W/Dd/inner  file, holds SECRET, Dd is covered by a bind of a directory
   *                 whose "inner" holds MASK
   *     W/own       directory of uid 1000 with the file "mine" and the
   *                 directory "minedir", whose "inner" holds MINE
   *     W/dbg       debugfs, mode 755. dbg/tracing is an automount point
   * The "attacker" is uid 1000. It enters a new user namespace with a new mount
   * namespace, so W and both covers are locked there.
   *
   * usage: prog MODE
   *   plain      put a bind of own/mine beneath the cover of D, unmount the cover
   *   nsfile     put a bind of the mount namespace file of a child beneath the
   *              cover of D, then unshare(CLONE_NEWNS)
   *   nsfile-control    the same with a bind of own/mine
   *   shrink     put a bind of the automounted tracefs beneath the cover of Dd,
   *              unmount the cover, put a tmpfs beneath W, call umount(W), which fails
   *   shrink-control    the same with a bind of own/minedir
   * The environment variable AUTOMOUNT_DIR names another automount point for "shrink".
   */
  #define _GNU_SOURCE
  #include <errno.h>
  #include <fcntl.h>
  #include <grp.h>
  #include <sched.h>
  #include <signal.h>
  #include <stdio.h>
  #include <stdlib.h>
  #include <string.h>
  #include <unistd.h>

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

firewire: core: fix race condition in split transaction handling

For a split transaction, either fw_core_handle_response() or
split_transaction_timeout_callback() may manipulate the same transaction
entry in the pending transaction list. The return value of timer_delete()
is used to determine which function handles the entry. If the transaction
is a split transaction and timer_delete() returns zero, the timeout
callback may already be running. In this case, the response handler must
leave the entry in the list for the timeout callback to remove.

A previous code refactoring broke this behavior, introducing a race
condition in which both functions could process the same transaction.
This could lead to a use-after-free on the transaction initiator side.

Fix the regression by ensuring that the response handler does not process
the transaction when timer_delete() returns zero. The timeout callback is
responsible for removing the entry from the pending transaction list.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Drivers: hv: Don't reset VMBus connection state on error/exit paths

In two places, current code forces vmbus_connection.conn_state to
DISCONNECTED prior to calling vmbus_disconnect(). But vmbus_disconnect()
calls vmbus_initiate_unload(), which unloads the VMBus connection
only if the conn_state is CONNECTED. Consequently, the connection
remains and the Hyper-V host might continue to send messages or post
VMBus interrupts.

The problem was introduced in commit 74347a99e73ae ("x86/Hyper-V:
Unload vmbus channel in hv panic callback"), in that
vmbus_initiate_unload() started checking the current connection
state before doing the unload. This commit removed some occurrences
where conn_state was forced to DISCONNECTED, but these two remained,
apparently due to an oversight at the time.

Fix this by not forcing conn_state to DISCONNECTED during VMBus exit,
or if a failure occurs when establishing the connection in the first
place. Whatever value conn_state has at the time is then read by
vmbus_initiate_unload() to determine if there is a connection to
be unloaded.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

xfs: fix capability check in xfs

An user reported a bug where he managed to evade group's quota
by changing a file's gid to a different group id the same user
belonged to, even though quotas were enforced on both gids and the
file's size was big enough to exceed the quota's hardlimit.

Commit eba0549bc7d1 replaced a capable() call by a
has_capability_noaudit() to prevent unnecessary selinux audit messages.
Turns out that both calls have slightly different semantics even though
their documentation seems similar. Where in a nutshell:

capable() - Tests the task's effective credentials
has_ns_capability_noaudit() - Tests the task's real credentials

This most of the time has no practical difference but in some cases like
changing attrs (specifically group id in this case) through a NFS client
this will allow the quota code to use XFS_QMOPT_FORCE_RES, effectively
bypassing quota accounting checks.

Using instead ns_capable_noaudit() should fix this issue and prevent
selinux audit messages.

This also fix the remaining calls to has_capability_noaudit()

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

scsi: libiscsi: Validate the ITT reflected in a Reject PDU

A Reject PDU carries a copy of the header it rejects, and
iscsi_handle_reject() takes the ITT out of that copy to find the task to
clean up:

      memcpy(&rejected_pdu, data, sizeof(struct iscsi_hdr));
      ...
      task = iscsi_itt_to_task(conn, rejected_pdu.itt);

That value is whatever the target put there. iscsi_itt_to_task() bounds
the index against cmds_max and checks nothing else, so any task in the
pool can be named, and iscsi_nop_out_rsp() then completes it.

An index that has never been used gives a NULL task->conn: the pool is
zeroed at session setup and conn is assigned only when a task is
allocated. If the task was used and returned, iscsi_complete_task() hits
its WARN_ON_ONCE(task->state == ISCSI_TASK_FREE) and the refcount
underflows. An in-flight SCSI command is completed as successful - a 1
MiB read returned 1048576 with none of its buffer written and no
warning.

Validate the reflected ITT the way iscsi_itt_to_ctask() validates a
command ITT, and require the task to be in flight and not a SCSI
command.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

scsi: libiscsi: Reject a negative task index from parse_pdu_itt

A transport that implements parse_pdu_itt hands libiscsi an index taken
from the PDU, and both lookups bound it from above only:

      if (i >= session->cmds_max)

i and cmds_max are both int, so a negative index passes and
session->cmds[i] is read from before the array.

be2iscsi produces one. beiscsi_parse_pdu() assigns the raw tag,

      *index = (int)itt;

and beiscsi_complete_pdu() forwards an unsolicited NOP-In from the
hardware async ring without replacing its ITT, so the value is the
target's. It also reports the session's own age rather than the one in
the tag, which leaves the age comparison in iscsi_verify_itt() with
nothing to reject.

Bound the index from below in both lookups.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

namespace: a mount that copy_tree() leaves out can't take over a lock

Since commit c62a4766937e ("move_mount: transfer MNT_LOCKED") a mount
can be moved beneath a locked mount. The lock moves from the old cover
to the new mount which takes over the job of hiding what's under it and
the old cover can be unmounted. That works as long as the new mount
stays. But the caller picks the new mount and copy_tree() leaves a
mount of a mount namespace file out of every copy made without
CL_COPY_MNT_NS_FILE, together with everything mounted on it, and never
looks at MNT_LOCKED. unshare(CLONE_NEWNS) and mount propagation make
such copies.

So a task that is root in its own user namespace gets rid of a locked
cover on a file without a race and without touching the filesystem
below it. It makes a child with a mount namespace of its own, binds the
child's /proc/<pid>/ns/mnt beneath the cover with MOVE_MOUNT_BENEATH,
which hands the lock to that bind, and calls unshare(CLONE_NEWNS). The
new mount namespace has nothing on the file. That's the usual way to
mask a single file, a bind of /dev/null or of an empty file. With a
bind of an ordinary file the file stays covered.

copy_tree() already refuses to leave out a locked unbindable mount with
-EPERM since commit df7342b24018 ("mount: Don't allow copying
MNT_UNBINDABLE|MNT_LOCKED mounts"). Do the same for a locked mount of a
mount namespace file. That also covers a tree copied with
CL_COPY_MNT_NS_FILE and attached into a mount namespace of another user
namespace where lock_mnt_tree() locks it. Note that unshare(CLONE_NEWNS)
and clone(CLONE_NEWNS) fail with EPERM from such a mount namespace from
then on. The mount can't be left out and it can't be unmounted.

And refuse to move a mount of a mount namespace file beneath a locked
mount in the first place. Otherwise the task ends up with a mount it
can't unmount and an unshare() that fails for good.

Chris also found a second mount that goes away by itself, a clone of an
automounted mount that shrink_submounts() took along with its parent.
Commit f78ddcc87224 ("namespace: never expire a locked mount") took
care of that one.

Chris's reproducer is appended. Mode nsfile reads SECRET after the
unshare() on 7.3-rc7, with this patch the move_mount() fails with
EINVAL and the file stays covered. nsfile-control uses an ordinary file
and reads MASK both ways.

  // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0
  /*
   * Get rid of a locked cover with MOVE_MOUNT_BENEATH.
   *
   * The "admin" (root) makes a tmpfs W:
   *     W/D         file, holds SECRET, covered by a bind of a file with MASK
   *     W/Dd/inner  file, holds SECRET, Dd is covered by a bind of a directory
   *                 whose "inner" holds MASK
   *     W/own       directory of uid 1000 with the file "mine" and the
   *                 directory "minedir", whose "inner" holds MINE
   *     W/dbg       debugfs, mode 755. dbg/tracing is an automount point
   * The "attacker" is uid 1000. It enters a new user namespace with a new mount
   * namespace, so W and both covers are locked there.
   *
   * usage: prog MODE
   *   plain      put a bind of own/mine beneath the cover of D, unmount the cover
   *   nsfile     put a bind of the mount namespace file of a child beneath the
   *              cover of D, then unshare(CLONE_NEWNS)
   *   nsfile-control    the same with a bind of own/mine
   *   shrink     put a bind of the automounted tracefs beneath the cover of Dd,
   *              unmount the cover, put a tmpfs beneath W, call umount(W), which fails
   *   shrink-control    the same with a bind of own/minedir
   * The environment variable AUTOMOUNT_DIR names another automount point for "shrink".
   */
  #define _GNU_SOURCE
  #include <errno.h>
  #include <fcntl.h>
  #include <grp.h>
  #include <sched.h>
  #include <signal.h>
  #include <stdio.h>
  #include <stdlib.h>
  #include <string.h>
  #include <unistd.h>

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

firewire: core: fix race condition in split transaction handling

For a split transaction, either fw_core_handle_response() or
split_transaction_timeout_callback() may manipulate the same transaction
entry in the pending transaction list. The return value of timer_delete()
is used to determine which function handles the entry. If the transaction
is a split transaction and timer_delete() returns zero, the timeout
callback may already be running. In this case, the response handler must
leave the entry in the list for the timeout callback to remove.

A previous code refactoring broke this behavior, introducing a race
condition in which both functions could process the same transaction.
This could lead to a use-after-free on the transaction initiator side.

Fix the regression by ensuring that the response handler does not process
the transaction when timer_delete() returns zero. The timeout callback is
responsible for removing the entry from the pending transaction list.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Drivers: hv: Don't reset VMBus connection state on error/exit paths

In two places, current code forces vmbus_connection.conn_state to
DISCONNECTED prior to calling vmbus_disconnect(). But vmbus_disconnect()
calls vmbus_initiate_unload(), which unloads the VMBus connection
only if the conn_state is CONNECTED. Consequently, the connection
remains and the Hyper-V host might continue to send messages or post
VMBus interrupts.

The problem was introduced in commit 74347a99e73ae ("x86/Hyper-V:
Unload vmbus channel in hv panic callback"), in that
vmbus_initiate_unload() started checking the current connection
state before doing the unload. This commit removed some occurrences
where conn_state was forced to DISCONNECTED, but these two remained,
apparently due to an oversight at the time.

Fix this by not forcing conn_state to DISCONNECTED during VMBus exit,
or if a failure occurs when establishing the connection in the first
place. Whatever value conn_state has at the time is then read by
vmbus_initiate_unload() to determine if there is a connection to
be unloaded.

**超過 1.3 萬個企業內部截圖與錄影檔案被上傳至 GitHub 公開儲存庫**。

raw.title: AI代理為完成任務卻外洩企業資料，逾1.3萬個內部檔案遭公開至GitHub
raw.desc: AI程式開發代理可能為了完成任務，自行採取不安全的操作方式，導致企業內部資料外洩。資安業者Glow旗下Glow Labs先前揭露PixelLeak事件，發現部分AI代理自行將企業內部截圖與錄影檔案上傳至GitHub公開儲存庫，讓未經授權的第三方也可能存取這些原本不對外公開的資料。

events.title: Cloudflare推出後量子地理金鑰管理，限定私密金鑰使用地區
pts: Cloudflare推出PQ GeoKey Manager服務，導入後量子密碼學防護，**可限定企業私密金鑰解密與使用的伺服器地區**。
該服務目前處於封閉測試階段，預計2027年第一季推出，將優先套用至Cloudflare One相關服務。

raw.title: Cloudflare推出後量子地理金鑰管理，限定私密金鑰使用地區
raw.desc: 網路服務與資安業者Cloudflare公布地理金鑰管理服務PQ GeoKey Manager，加入後量子密碼學（PQC）防護，讓企業指定哪些地區的伺服器可以解密及使用私密金鑰。目前這項服務已進入封閉測試階段，預計2027年第一季正式推出。新架構將先應用於Cloudflare One相關服務。

events.title: Linux基金會調查揭資料基礎架構風險，資安漏洞居首
pts: Linux基金會調查顯示，58%受訪者最關注資料基礎架構的資安漏洞風險，**資安與法規遵循成為選擇平臺關鍵**。
該調查於2026年5月進行，共有294名受訪者參與，79%受訪者認為資安與法規遵循非常重要。

raw.title: Linux基金會調查揭資料基礎架構風險，資安漏洞居首
raw.desc: Linux基金會（The Linux Foundation）公布2026年開放資料基礎架構調查，發現58%受訪者關注資料基礎架構的資安漏洞風險，在各項風險中比例最高；法規遵循，以及資料在不同工具或環境中的暴露風險，則各有33%受訪者關注。在選擇資料平臺時，79%受訪者認為資安與法規遵循非常重要，比例與重視總持有成本（Total Cost of Ownership，TCO）的80%相近。這項調查於2026年5月進行，共有294名來自不同產業及組織的受訪者參與。

events.title: VMware ESX 日誌不足漏洞
pts: Broadcom VMware ESX 存在日誌記錄不足漏洞，可讓具管理員權限的惡意人士執行特定操作而不留下日誌紀錄。
**此漏洞已遭利用**。攻擊條件為需要取得系統的管理員存取權限。
events.fix: 依原廠公告套用修補或緩解措施，無法修補時停用該產品。

raw.name: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
raw.desc: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.
raw.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

events.title: Linux Kernel 未初始化漏洞
pts: Linux Kernel 存在變數未初始化漏洞，可修改快取資料，並結合其他漏洞植入 PHP webshell 以 root 權限執行指令。
**此漏洞已遭利用**。可串聯 CVE-2026-109618 及 CVE-2026-109619 進行攻擊。
events.fix: 依原廠公告套用修補或緩解措施，無法修補時停用該產品。

raw.name: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
raw.desc: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.
raw.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

events.title: 預防SBOM清單也可能遭竄改，歐盟ENISA發布技術指南，提出生命週期安全防護建議
pts: 歐盟ENISA發布SBOM技術指南，提出涵蓋產生、驗證、簽署、儲存、使用及維護的**六階段生命週期管理流程**，防範SBOM清單遭竄改。
指南建議將SBOM管理整合至CI/CD流程，並整理開源工具與防護建議，協助廠商符合歐盟網路韌性法（CRA）義務。

raw.title: 預防SBOM清單也可能遭竄改，歐盟ENISA發布技術指南，提出生命週期安全防護建議
raw.desc: 為提升軟體供應鏈透明度，歐盟網路韌性法（CRA）要求產品製造商履行相關資安義務，包括提供軟體物料清單（SBOM）等要求，然而，SBOM不只要盤點軟體元件，還須確保清單正確、持續更新，並防範竄改。歐盟網路安全局（ENISA）於10月22日正式發布SBOM技術指南，提出六階段生命週期管理流程，涵蓋產生、驗證、簽署、儲存、使用及維護，並建議整合至持續整合與持續交付（CI/CD）流程，同時整理可用的開源工具與安全防護建議。

events.title: Burrito Webhook 驗證漏洞
pts: 影響 0.13.0 前之 Burrito，攻擊者可偽造事件觸發未授權的 **`terraform plan` 並可能洩露變更內容**。
目前未發現遭利用情形，攻擊者需能存取服務端點並得知追蹤儲存庫之 URL。
events.fix: 升級至 Burrito 0.13.0 以上版本。

raw.desc: Burrito is a Terraform Automation Collaboration Software (TACoS) Kubernetes operator. Prior to 0.13.0, `POST /api/webhook` accepts unsigned GitHub and GitLab events when a `TerraformRepository`'s credentials omit `webhookSecret` or set it to an empty value, including credentials configured for git authentication and polling. `Credential.WebhookSecret` is optional, and `go-playground/webhooks` skips signature or token verification when the secret is empty. Anyone who can reach `burrito-server`'s endpoint and knows a tracked repository's URL can forge events to create or delete `TerraformPullRequest` custom resources with attacker-chosen `Branch`, `Base`, and `ID` fields. For GitHub `pull_request` events, the controller fetches changed files using the real pull request number but does not cross-check the payload's branch against that pull request. Pairing a real, existing pull request number with an unrelated existing branch in the same repository can therefore cause an unauthorized `terraform plan` for affected layers using the operator's stored git and cloud credentials. Code analysis also indicates that the resulting plan can be posted to the real pull request's comment thread, exposing and misattributing another branch's infrastructure changes. Auto-apply is disabled for these temporary layers, so this vulnerability alone cannot force a `terraform apply`; plan-time provider and data-source code execution depends on the selected branch's contents. This issue is fixed in version 0.13.0.

events.title: vLLM 推理引擎多項安全漏洞
pts: vLLM 0.32.0 之前版本存在共享記憶體位址偽造與圖像解碼限制缺失漏洞，影響大型語言模型推理與服務引擎運作。
目前未遭利用。攻擊條件包含經身分驗證的呼叫者偽造資料，或傳送控管之圖像位元組。
events.fix: **升級至 0.32.0 或以上版本。**

descs: vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.32.0, an authenticated caller can place forged shared-memory address and monotonic_id values in public multimodal features.kwargs_data. In scale-out deployments with shared-memory multimodal caching enabled, workers trust those values and pass attacker-selected bytes to pickle.loads(), allowing arbitrary Python execution even when insecure serialization is disabled. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.32.0, ImageMediaIO passes attacker-controlled image bytes to Pillow through Image.open(BytesIO(data)) without restricting decoder selection, and the MIME label does not constrain the selected format. Image-capable request paths through parse_image() and fetch_image() can therefore dispatch an EPS payload to host components. A host with Ghostscript affected by CVE-2024-29510 can execute commands with the vLLM process's privileges, while environments using Pillow 12.0.0 through 12.2.0 can trigger CVE-2026-59203 and exhaust media-loading workers. Deployments without the applicable vulnerable dependency are not affected by that corresponding impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

events.title: hackney憑證驗證漏洞
pts: 影響 hackney 1.24.0 至 4.9.0 以前版本。hackney_ssl 存在憑證驗證漏洞，攻擊者可藉由公開信任根憑證冒充伺服器。
**目前尚未發現漏洞遭利用**。攻擊條件為攻擊者需擁有經固定主機名稱的公開信任憑證。
events.fix: 升級至 4.9.0 以上版本

raw.desc:
Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in hackney_ssl in benoitc hackney allows an on-path attacker to impersonate a server pinned to a private certificate authority via a certificate chain that ends in a publicly trusted root. hackney adds {partial_chain, fun hackney_ssl:partial_chain/1} to every verify_peer configuration. The callback returns any certificate in the peer chain whose public key matches a root in the bundled certifi store as the trust anchor, and OTP honours that callback over the configured cacerts. hackney_ssl:merge_ssl_opts/3 kept the callback when the caller replaced the trust store with cacerts or cacertfile in ssl_options, so a connection pinned to a private CA still accepted any chain that carried a publicly trusted root.

The hostname check still applies, so the attacker needs a publicly trusted certificate for the pinned hostname.

This issue affects hackney: from 1.24.0 before 4.9.0.

events.title: vLLM AI 平台多重安全漏洞
pts: 影響 vLLM 多個版本，漏洞可導致 SSRF、輸入驗證繞過與伺服器阻斷服務。
CVSS 評分為 8.8，**目前相關漏洞皆未發現遭惡意利用或勒索軟體利用**。

descs: vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC converter that allows remote attackers to bypass max_logprobs limits via CandidateTokens.top_n. Attackers can send Generate or GenerateStream requests with oversized or integer-wrapping top_n values to trigger torch.topk failures that terminate EngineCore.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to terminate EngineCore by bypassing logprob_token_ids limits in the Rust gRPC frontend. Attackers can send Generate or GenerateStream requests with output_logprobs enabled and more than 128 output_candidates.token_ids, triggering a fatal sampler exception that crashes the engine.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC Generate and GenerateStream service that forwards unchecked prompt token IDs to EngineCore. Attackers can submit requests with out-of-vocabulary prompt.token_ids values to trigger a fatal embedding lookup failure that terminates EngineCore and leaves the server unhealthy.

vLLM from 0.9.2 before 0.24.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows API callers to force outbound connections by embedding a decode address in the X-Request-Id header. Attackers can make a P2pNcclConnector prefill worker ZMQ-connect to an attacker host, leaking the NCCL unique_id and KV-cache tensors or blocking the worker.

vLLM from 0.10.2 before 0.25.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory because the Nemotron-VL processors globally set Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None. Attackers can submit a pathological decompression-bomb image to /v1/chat/completions to OOM-kill the worker and deny service to co-tenants.

vLLM from 0.20.0 before 0.30.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to crash the engine by sending inconsistent multimodal metadata to the disaggregated /inference/v1/generate endpoint. Attackers can replay a valid multimodal item with repeated or overlapping mm_placeholders ranges or mismatched kwargs_data and mm_hashes lists, producing a negative text span in Qwen2.5-VL position construction that terminates the engine.

vLLM from 0.18.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows API clients to bypass the video/jpeg frame-count cap by overriding num_frames through media_io_kwargs. Attackers can set num_frames to -1 with a large inline video so VideoMediaIO.load_base64 decodes every frame, exhausting memory and crashing the API frontend.

vLLM from 0.8.5 before 0.31.0 has a denial of service flaw. LogprobsTensors.empty_cpu() in vllm/v1/outputs.py allocates an uninitialized int32 tensor, and the V1 model runner leaves prompt positions reported as computed by a KV connector unwritten. A client sharing the engine can send prompt_logprobs (or echo with logprobs) against a connector-cached prefix, making tokenizer decode raise OverflowError, which crashes EngineCore and drops all co-tenant requests.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC Generate and GenerateStream service that forwards unchecked prompt token IDs to EngineCore. Attackers can submit requests with out-of-vocabulary prompt.token_ids values to trigger a fatal embedding lookup failure that terminates EngineCore and leaves the server unhealthy.

vLLM from 0.10.2 before 0.25.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory because the Nemotron-VL processors globally set Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None. Attackers can submit a pathological decompression-bomb image to /v1/chat/completions to OOM-kill the worker and deny service to co-tenants.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC converter that allows remote attackers to bypass max_logprobs limits via CandidateTokens.top_n. Attackers can send Generate or GenerateStream requests with oversized or integer-wrapping top_n values to trigger torch.topk failures that terminate EngineCore.

vLLM from 0.9.2 before 0.24.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows API callers to force outbound connections by embedding a decode address in the X-Request-Id header. Attackers can make a P2pNcclConnector prefill worker ZMQ-connect to an attacker host, leaking the NCCL unique_id and KV-cache tensors or blocking the worker.

events.title: Apache 遠端執行程式碼漏洞
pts: 影響 Goobi viewer 24.03 至 26.05 之前版本，檔名處理不當可致路徑穿越與遠端執行程式碼。
目前未遭利用。**惡意 HTTP 伺服器可傳送穿越序列並以 tomcat 權限執行程式碼**。
events.fix: 升級至 26.05 以上版本。

raw.desc: The Goobi viewer is a web application that allows digitised material to be displayed in a web browser. From version 24.03 to before version 26.05, ExternalFilesDownloader.getFilename() extracts the destination filename from a server-supplied Content-Disposition response header and passes it directly to Path.resolve() without stripping directory components. This allows for a malicious HTTP server that the viewer fetches from to supply an absolute path or ../ traversal sequences as the filename, writing attacker-controlled content to an arbitrary path writable by the Tomcat process. When targeting the deployed web-application directory, this yields remote code execution as the tomcat OS user. This issue has been patched in version 26.05.

events.title: Linux與Wasmtime多項漏洞
pts: Wasmtime 24.0.13、25.0.0 至 36.0.14、37.0.0 至 46.0.3 及 47.0.0 至 47.0.4 前版本存在沙盒逃脫漏洞，Linux 核心亦有多項缺陷。

descs: Wasmtime before 24.0.13, 25.0.0 before 36.0.14, 37.0.0 before 46.0.3, and 47.0.0 before 47.0.4 allows a filesystem sandbox escape in wasmtime-wasi because its cap-std dependency mishandles symlinks with trailing slashes on macOS and Linux kernels lacking openat2. A guest with write access to any sandboxed directory can read and write any host-accessible file, and read-only guests may read host files via preexisting symlinks.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

amt: send the relay's General Query directly from the receive path

An skb queued in a qdisc can outlive the tunnel it references
through a raw pointer in skb->cb. For example, with igmp_qrv set
to 1 on the relay a tunnel lives for 135s, so a netem delay of
180s on the amt device outlives it; when the tunnel expires and is
freed, the subsequent dequeue triggers a use-after-free in
amt_dev_xmit().

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in amt_dev_xmit+0x2763/0x2e20
  Call Trace:
   amt_dev_xmit+0x2763/0x2e20 [drivers/net/amt.c:1262]
   dev_hard_start_xmit+0x22f/0x620
   sch_direct_xmit+0x12e/0xac0
   netem_dequeue+0x333/0xc50
   net_tx_action+0x35c/0xa60

amt_send_igmp_gq() and amt_send_mld_gq() are only called from
amt_request_handler(), inside the rcu_read_lock_bh() section of
amt_rcv(). amt_request_handler() already has the tunnel the query is
for: it found or created it inside that section. Queuing the query with
dev_queue_xmit() only leads back into amt_dev_xmit(), which strips the
Ethernet header and calls amt_send_membership_query() for that tunnel.

Make that call directly from the two senders instead, the same way
amt_send_advertisement() transmits from the receive path. The query
never waits in a qdisc, the tunnel is only dereferenced inside the
RCU section that found or created it, and nothing is stored in
skb->cb, so no lookup or refcount is needed. Remove the query branch
of amt_dev_xmit(), amt_skb_cb() and struct amt_skb_cb, which have no
users left.

Behaviour changes:
 - The relay's own General Queries no longer pass through the amt
   device's egress path: its qdisc, tc egress (clsact/tcx), the
   netfilter egress hook and packet taps. They are still visible as
   UDP on the underlay.
 - A query that is sent successfully is no longer counted as
   tx_dropped. The old query branch left through the unlock label,
   which counted every sent query as dropped.
 - A query that reaches amt_dev_xmit() on a relay from elsewhere,
   such as a userspace querier, is now dropped at the IGMP/MLD type
   switch. Before, it trusted whatever skb->cb held, and a NULL
   tunnel hit the WARN_ON(1).

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

namespace: unhash a dentry before detaching the mounts on it

unlink(), rmdir() and rename() remove the entry from the filesystem,
call detach_mounts() on the entry with the inode locked and then call
d_delete() once the inode is unlocked.

The thing is that between detach_mounts() and d_delete() the dentry is
still hashed and positive. But after detach_mounts() nothing covers the
dentry anymore. A lookup that finds this dentry in the dcache can
uncover what the mounts hid.

That's a problem when unlinking files or directories that are
mountpoints in other mount namespaces. Everybody who had the underlying
entry covered can race the detach_mount() call until d_delete() has run.

The race window isn't all that small. It encompasses namespace_unlock()
with a full synchronize_rcu_expedited() grace period and the
inode_unlock() of the entry.

In my experiments three walkers that kept trying read an overmounted
file in 11938 of the 16140 unlinks that removed its mountpoint from a
bind mount of the filesystem within a minute.

Fun fact, d_invalidate() has the same ordering problem but gets it
right. It unhashes the dentry first and detaches the mounts afterwards.
Let's do the same in __detach_mounts():

- A lookup that hasn't found the dentry yet misses it in the dcache and
  waits for the directory lock that the caller holds until the name is
  gone for good.

- A lockless lookup that found it already fails the mount_lock check
  while the dentry still counts as a mountpoint and the d_seq check once
  it doesn't, and retries.

This fixes the lockless path. We still need to fix the reference count
lookup in a follow-up patch.

So d_drop() the dentry. The dentry stays positive and held but can't be
found anymore. Then proceed with the detach and unlink.

Reproducer:

The reads were counted with the program below, three walkers for 60 s
in a VM with 4 CPUs. The race window is stretched with the debug patch
pasted here. fs.detach_race_walk_us sleeps in lookup_fast() once it

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: x86: Use active memslots for the per-vCPU MMIO cache

KVM tags the per-vCPU MMIO cache with a memslot generation so that a
memslot update invalidates cached MMIO information.  Both the fill and
validation paths use kvm_memslots(), which unconditionally selects address
space 0, even when the vCPU is running in SMM and using address space 1.

Commit 56f17dd3fbc4 ("kvm: x86: fix stale mmio cache bug") added the
memslot generation to the cache key so that a memslot update could not
leave a stale entry valid.  When commit 699023e23965 ("KVM: x86: add SMM
to the MMU role, support SMRAM address space") added the SMM address space,
these helpers were not converted to use the active memslots.

Consequently, an update to the SMM memslots can leave an entry from the old
SMM address space apparently valid after the vCPU returns to the normal
address space.  A guest can then cause an access to valid RAM at the same
GFN to be returned to userspace as KVM_EXIT_MMIO.

Completing that exit through the VMM's RAM address space writes the backing
page without going through KVM's write-tracking path.  If the page backs a
nested EPT table, KVM can continue using shadow translations derived from
the old contents.  The WARN_ON_ONCE() in kvm_mmu_write_protect_fault()
catches this invalid cache and memslot combination.

Use the vCPU's active memslots when caching and validating the entry.
Memslot generations are unique across address spaces, so the generation
also distinguishes the normal and SMM views.  This matches the MMIO SPTE
cache, which already uses kvm_vcpu_memslots().

On an unpatched current-mainline kernel, a regression test that fills the
cache in SMM and updates only the SMM memslots fails the intended RAM write
and triggers the kvm_mmu_write_protect_fault() warning.  With this change,
the same test completes the RAM write without a warning.  The x86/smm_test,
set_memory_region_test, and memslot_modification_stress_test selftests also
pass.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: fix heap out-of-bounds write in krb5_authenticate()

In krb5_authenticate(), out_len is calculated to determine available
headroom in response_buf for the incoming Kerberos AP-REP token. However,
when SMB2_SESSION_SETUP is processed as a non-first element of a compounded
SMB2 request, the calculation omits work->next_smb2_rsp_hdr_off.

This causes out_len to overstate remaining buffer headroom by
the cumulative size of prior responses in the compound chain. Consequently,
the length check in ksmbd_krb5_authenticate()
(*out_len <= resp->spnego_blob_len) passes erroneously, allowing memcpy()
to write the AP-REP blob past the end of response_buf into adjacent kernel
heap memory.

Fix this by subtracting work->next_smb2_rsp_hdr_off when computing out_len,
ensuring it accurately reflects physical remaining buffer space.

events.title: LiteLLM 權限提升漏洞
pts: 影響 LiteLLM 1.87.0 至 1.100.4、1.101.3、1.102.2、1.103.1 等版本，驗證使用者可偽造管理者身份並執行任意指令。
1.87.0 至 1.90.x 需啟用特定登入設定，1.91.0 後預設組態即可利用；目前未遭利用。

raw.desc: LiteLLM is a proxy server (AI Gateway) to call LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format. From 1.87.0 until 1.100.4, 1.101.3, 1.102.2, 1.103.1, and 1.104.0-rc.2, the proxy reuses one cryptographic context for at-rest secrets and session tokens, allowing an authenticated internal user to have crafted metadata containing a forged administrator credential encrypted and returned by the API-key flow. Replaying that ciphertext as a bearer token causes the proxy to trust the forged proxy administrator identity, permitting administrative access and arbitrary commands through the MCP stdio endpoint. Versions 1.87.0 through 1.90.x require EXPERIMENTAL_UI_LOGIN to be enabled, while versions after 1.91.0 are exploitable in the default configuration. This issue was fixed in LiteLLM 1.100.4, 1.101.3, 1.102.2, 1.103.1, and 1.104.0-rc.2.

events.title: Bytebase 驗證繞過漏洞
pts: Bytebase 0.12.0 至 1.0.1 未滿版本存在身分驗證繞過漏洞，未經驗證攻擊者可冒用既有使用者或建立新成員。
目前**未遭積極利用**，攻擊者可透過 POST /api/auth/login/GITLAB_SELF_HOST 端點發送偽造設定。

raw.desc: Bytebase 0.12.0 before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user. The flaw stems from trusting client-supplied GitLab provider configuration in the POST /api/auth/login/GITLAB_SELF_HOST endpoint. Attackers can set instanceUrl to a server they control that returns an active user with a chosen email. Bytebase then issues session tokens for that principal, letting attackers impersonate existing users including the Owner or create new members.

events.title: Brotli 緩衝區溢位漏洞
pts: Google Brotli 1.0.3 至 1.2.0 版本存在緩衝區溢位漏洞，未經驗證的遠端攻擊者可損壞記憶體或執行程式碼。
目前**未遭積極利用**，攻擊者可透過精心設計的 Brotli 壓縮串流發動攻擊。

raw.desc:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.
